Thanks Marissa / Emily - I'll prepare the tech appendix. A few items I want to confirm ahead of the call so we don't get surprised:

- Can you confirm whether you require customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) or if a Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable for the POC?

- Are you expecting TLS+mTLS between services for the integration?

If procurement/security can drop a short note here, I'll tailor the slides and bring a small runbook for the eval that maps tests to acceptance criteria (latency measurements, cost burn tests, failover).

Marissa / Marcus - confirmed. Rajesh is available Tue 12/1 10:00-11:00 PT. Procurement and Security confirmed the slot as well.

Quick answers:
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed KMS for production, but Redwood-managed is OK for the POC if the offer includes a path to BYOK.
- Residency: US-only for now (we'll need to discuss EU later).
- Concurrency: initial pilot ~50 concurrent users, peak ~200 concurrent during batch processing windows; estimate ~150k tokens/min peak for the pilot workload.
- TLS+ mTLS required for service-to-service.

Procurement attached a short checklist and asked if you can provide an initial pricing quote and SOW draft before the call. Also adding a DocuSign NDA link for the data rooms - https://docusign.example.com/ndas/FD-2026-00123

See you Tue.
